name: claim_representative_list
xsql:
SELECT DISTINCT pa.name AS rep_name
FROM   xactly.xc_participant pa
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa
    ON ppa.participant_id = pa.participant_id
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos
    ON pos.position_id = ppa.position_id
WHERE  pa.is_master = 1
  AND  ( Nvl(:v_manager, '') = 'All'
         OR Nvl(:v_manager, '') = ''
         OR pos.master_position_id IN
            ( SELECT ph.to_pos_id
              FROM   xactly.xc_pos_hierarchy ph
              INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position mgr_pos
                  ON mgr_pos.master_position_id = ph.from_pos_id
              INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment mgr_ppa
                  ON mgr_ppa.position_id = mgr_pos.position_id
              INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant mgr_pa
                  ON  mgr_pa.participant_id = mgr_ppa.participant_id
                  AND mgr_pa.is_master      = 1
              WHERE  mgr_pa.name = :v_manager ) )
ORDER BY pa.name
